d:
Jack's life was stolen. Now, she's Jill. Can she embrace her new identity? And what's the cost of fighting against those who'd seek to control not only her body but also her soul?

This is Phase 1, 2, and 3 of 9 total. More will be added soon!

If you like the comic and can't wait for more, check out my Patreon!
